_help: Fill these in to switch them on, then rebuild. Leave empty to keep them off.

google_ads_conversions._help: Optional: conversion labels from Google Ads (Goals > Conversions > Tag setup), written as AW-17981726466/AbC-xyz. When set, these site events count as conversions in Google Ads. generate_lead (enquiry forms and the tour booking sheet, which open WhatsApp) uses the WhatsApp label too; a form send does not also fire whatsapp_click, so nothing is counted twice.

_payment_help: online_payment_activities: set true (and rebuild) only after NOMOD_API_KEY is in kwikar-config.php and a test payment worked. It shows the Pay now button on activity booking sheets and switches the Terms, Refund, Privacy and Booking information wording to online payment for activities.
